judgement.reason: Coolify is a Laravel web app on PostgreSQL and Redis, and splitting its s6 services into workers is a contained change, so the outcome stands.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported container setup: docker/production/Dockerfile runs s6-overlay with 4 long-running services (horizon, reverb, scheduler-worker, terminal-server) in one container. Deployz runs one web process and declared workers as separate services.
reviews.reason: The shown Dockerfile lines do not disprove that the production image runs several long-running s6-overlay services in one container, so the finding stays for you to confirm.
